verdict.rationale: Together AI documents a single serverless API covering chat, image, audio and embeddings. It has dedicated docs for text-to-image generation, image editing with reference images, and video generation, including audio-driven video, so a developer can clearly go beyond text chat on one platform. missing for 10: explicit vision/image-understanding input documentation, dedicated audio (speech-to-text/text-to-speech) endpoint docs beyond a one-line mention, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can call vision, audio, or image-generation models beyond text chat on the same platform

citations.quote: Call chat, image, audio, embedding, and more through one API.
Edit or transform an existing image by passing image_url (Kontext) or reference_images (FLUX.2 and Google models).
Generate videos from text and image prompts.
Drive video generation with an audio file for lip sync, beat-matched motion, or narration.
